name: Teen Leaders Club
what_you_do: A leadership and community service club that lasts a year. Teens lead service projects, get leadership training and help with YMCA programs.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school teens. Tampa YMCA membership is required. Parents and teens must attend at least one info meeting.
deadline_text: Join any time through your local Y family center.
how_to_apply: Join the Tampa YMCA. Contact the Club Advisor at your Y. Go to a meeting. Sign up at that Y.
notes: The page says it is at every Tampa Y family center.
